overloads.semanticRole: Replaces the current database's user accounts and groups with the contents of the encrypted users BLOB previously produced by USERS TO BLOB.

constraints: users must be a BLOB previously created by USERS TO BLOB; it is encrypted.
Only the database Administrator or Designer may execute this command; any other caller gets a no-op plus privilege error -9949.

In a project database, this only migrates users/groups into directory.json (all existing entries there are replaced except "Designer"/"Administrator"); in a binary database, all negative-reference-number (Administrator-created) users/groups are removed and replaced by the BLOB's contents.
